blocks.text: When the examiner puts an X-ray in front of you, **don't stare at it trying to remember a disease picture**.

**“First, I will identify the film and assess its technical quality. I will then systematically review the relevant anatomy, describe any abnormalities, interpret them in context, give my most likely diagnosis and state the appropriate next step.”**
That makes you sound like a clinician rather than someone trying to guess an image.
